rate_limits.correction: Online Booking APIs allow at most 1,000 requests per rolling 30-second window; other OpenTable APIs may have different limits.

description.correction: OpenTable provides approval-gated APIs for restaurant data, availability, bookings, reservations, guests, and integrations. Production access requires review and a formal agreement. OAuth 2.0 is the primary authorization mechanism, and current public documentation is hosted at docs.opentable.com.

notes: Official status reporting shows the Consumer, Network Access, and Restaurant Partner APIs operational. The entry nevertheless fails because its documentation URL, authentication classification, rate-limit claim, example request, and documentation-host statement are wrong. OpenTable publishes no universal self-serve price or free-tier entitlement; API cost and availability are communicated during approval and contracting.
